leader_responsibilities: Discuss and frame the specific situation with the user before freezing the review problem.
Retrieve current durable Garden/repository state needed for the situation.
Triage review depth based on materiality, ambiguity, reversibility, security, rights and implementation risk.
Freeze one source/problem packet before blind review.
Coordinate independent ChatGPT worker branches and the governed OpenRouter branch.
Preserve blind independence until outputs are frozen.
Compare disagreements and preserve minority/blocking findings; never decide by majority vote alone.
Create the integrated candidate and decision log.
Use an independent verifier/process-audit phase before final integration when material.
Make the final coordinator decision subject to applicable Garden/GSL/human authority gates.
Update durable repository state when the review produces repo-relevant work.

chatgpt_workers.qualifying_context: No Garden project context, no relevant memory/personal-context/prior-chat exposure, and no peer/reviewer output before semantic freeze.

triage.decision_rule: Use the highest triggered class. SMALL is permitted only when every SMALL condition is satisfied. Any MATERIAL trigger upgrades to MATERIAL. Any HIGH_RISK trigger upgrades to HIGH_RISK.

all_required: no rights, authority, legal, safety, security, privacy or secret-bearing effect
no real-world actuation or consequential external action
localized to one owner/module with no material cross-layer dependency change
no new or changed schema, invariant, constitutional rule or foundational architecture
failure blast radius is local and easily recoverable
small.board: ONE_BLIND_CHATGPT_WORKER_PLUS_LEADER_CHECK; verifier optional only if no higher-risk trigger appears.

any_trigger: new or changed schema, invariant, FunctionContract or persistent-state semantics
cross-module, cross-owner, cross-layer or cross-repository dependency effect
nontrivial migration, compatibility or integration decision
material evidence disagreement or unresolved assumption
meaningful cost, performance, reliability or user-impact tradeoff
failure requires coordinated rollback or affects durable shared state
security-sensitive, credential-bearing, secret-bearing or privacy-sensitive data/action
production deployment, consequential real-world actuation or safety-critical physical effect
broad human-effect blast radius or many affected parties
canonical/foundational Garden architecture or constitutional semantics
destructive migration, deletion, external enforcement or lockout risk
high uncertainty combined with high consequence
high_risk.board: FULL_BOARD_REQUIRED; verifier/process audit mandatory; applicable human/Garden authority gate mandatory; stronger assurance/review profile as required, with expensive models only by explicit human opt-in.

manual_handoff_boundary.leader_should_minimize_user_work: Generate exact worker packets/instructions and consume returned durable artifacts; do not ask the user to redesign the process.
manual_handoff_boundary.minimum_user_steps: Ask the user to open blind ChatGPT worker/verifier chats only when a qualifying isolated context is actually available. A fresh chat alone is insufficient. If product/project/memory context cannot be disabled or excluded, mark the ChatGPT blind lane BLOCKED_BY_CONTEXT_ISOLATION and continue only noncanonical repair/other permitted assurance work; do not ask the user to repeat identical chat-opening attempts.

closure_rule: When the user invokes 'group review', the current chat becomes Leader. The Leader uses the repo-native issue bus, explicit v2.1 triage, immutable source hashing, context-isolated blind workers when such isolation is actually available, governed external review lanes where authorized, hard-fail process auditing, frozen candidate/verifier artifacts, and durable resume checkpoints. Product context leakage is recorded as PROCESS_FAIL/BLOCKED_BY_CONTEXT_ISOLATION rather than hidden or retried indefinitely.

checks: identical frozen packets for symmetric blind workers
no peer output exposure before blind freeze
no silent edit of frozen worker artifacts
OpenRouter execution used the real governed API subprocess and durable receipt
privacy/data approval satisfied before any third-party model transmission
every blind source ref is immutable and every retrieved source matches its frozen SHA-256
blind ChatGPT workers attest absence of project/memory/prior-review context before semantic review
worker lifecycle reaches SOURCE_HASH_VERIFIED and BLIND_REVIEW only under verified context isolation
material_failures: non-identical blind packets without declared reason
peer leakage or premature peer-answer exposure
hash mismatch or unverifiable frozen artifact
silent mutation of a frozen worker result
simulated/chat-persona OpenRouter substituted for real API review when OpenRouter was required
unauthorized sensitive-data transmission to an external model
discarded blocking/minority finding without recorded disposition
mutable blind source reference or frozen source hash drift
project, memory, personal-context, prior-review or peer-output exposure before blind semantic freeze

on_material_failure.rerun_requirement: Create a clean run with a newly frozen packet/run identity; preserve the failed run as audit evidence.
on_material_failure.context_isolation_rule: One contaminated attempt may be rerun only in a materially different execution context that can exclude the prior source of leakage. If isolation is unavailable or a materially equivalent isolated attempt also receives excluded context, record BLOCKED_BY_CONTEXT_ISOLATION and stop automatic/user reruns until isolation capability changes.
on_material_failure.blocked_lane_effect: BLOCKED_BY_CONTEXT_ISOLATION is non-PASS and cannot satisfy required blind-worker quorum, but it does not prevent unrelated noncanonical analysis/repair from continuing.

process_audit.nonmaterial_failure_rule: Record as a caveat or repair before completion; never silently erase it.

run_issue.source_ref_rule: Blind source_refs MUST be exact-commit repo:<owner>/<repo>@<40hex>:<path> or content:sha256:<64hex>:<label>; mutable PR/branch/default-branch/web refs are forbidden.
run_issue.source_hash_rule: source_hashes is mandatory; keys exactly equal source_refs and each value is lowercase SHA-256 of the frozen source bytes.

worker_output.semantic_output_allowed_only_when: status=FROZEN_RESULT AND context_isolation.status=VERIFIED AND no excluded-context flags are true

optional_phone_models.rule: Use the exact frozen packet; return raw output unchanged; Leader hashes it as EXTERNAL_PHONE evidence. These workers never replace a required governed OpenRouter lane.

stop_resume.resume_rule: Leader retrieves the run issue and all currently frozen artifacts and continues from the last valid checkpoint.
